diff --git a/tools/start_session.sh b/tools/start_session.sh
new file mode 100755
index 0000000..d687491
--- /dev/null
+++ b/tools/start_session.sh
@@ -0,0 +1,20 @@
+#!/bin/bash
+# Copyright 2026 jerry
+#
+# Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0 (the "License");
+# you may not use this file except in compliance with the License.
+# You may obtain a copy of the License at
+#
+#     http://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0
+#
+# Unless required by applicable law or agreed to in writing, software
+# distributed under the License is distributed on an "AS IS" BASIS,
+# WITHOUT WARRANTIES OR CONDITIONS OF ANY KIND, either express or implied.
+# See the License for the specific language governing permissions and
+# limitations under the License.
+
+
+# Bash background jobs inherit SIGINT ignored. ROS launch relies on Python
+# receiving it to forward an orderly shutdown to its children. Reset before
+# Python starts, while preserving the session leader PID for bookkeeping.
+exec setsid env --default-signal=INT "$@"
diff --git a/tools/test_lane_processes.sh b/tools/test_lane_processes.sh
index 322c24c..dc00831 100755
--- a/tools/test_lane_processes.sh
+++ b/tools/test_lane_processes.sh
@@ -156,6 +156,26 @@ check "the child received exactly one INT" "1" "$(cat "$RUN_DIR/forwarded" 2>/de
 check "the managed child shut down normally" "0" "$(cat "$RUN_DIR/forwarded.root_result" 2>/dev/null)"
 check "managed shutdown has no escalation" "" "$(cat "$RUN_DIR/teardown")"
 
+echo "a background launch root receives its own INT instead of inheriting ignore"
+: > "$RUN_DIR/teardown"
+"$SCRIPT_DIR/start_session.sh" python3 -c '
+import sys,time
+from pathlib import Path
+marker=Path(sys.argv[1])
+marker.with_suffix(".ready").touch()
+try:
+    time.sleep(300)
+except KeyboardInterrupt:
+    marker.write_text("INT")
+' "$RUN_DIR/default_interrupt" &
+root=$!
+while [ ! -f "$RUN_DIR/default_interrupt.ready" ]; do sleep .01; done
+lane_remember 1 "$root"
+lane_teardown 1
+wait "$root" 2>/dev/null || true
+check "the real background root received INT" "INT" "$(cat "$RUN_DIR/default_interrupt" 2>/dev/null)"
+check "the background root needed no escalation" "" "$(cat "$RUN_DIR/teardown")"
+
 echo "a group that ignores TERM is killed, and that is reported"
 : > "$RUN_DIR/teardown"
 setsid bash -c 'trap "" TERM; sleep 300' &
